body.name: Encoded explicit-support decision language
body.construction: An input is \(\langle a,\delta,\{(i,y_i^{\mathrm{obs},\delta}):i\notin M(a)\},\Omega,\{w_z:z\in\Omega\},q\rangle\), where \(\delta\), the observed coordinates, the weights, and \(q\) are rational, \(\Omega\) is listed row by row, and the total binary length is \(\ell\). The input is accepted exactly when some \(b\in\mathcal C_\delta(a)\) has \(p(a,b)\ge q\).
